source: Bourgeade A, Auvergnat JC, Duchassin M, Kadio A. Diarrhees aigues en Cote d'Ivoire; place et aspect clinique des salmonelloses et des shigelloses. Bull Soc Med Afr Noire Lang Fr 1974;19(3):281-286 (PMID 4376062) - abstract in Tropical Diseases Bulletin 1975;72(10) no.2407
processing_notes: Source states: 'In 30 months 1895 patients were admitted to hospital at Abidjan with diarrhoea. 749 patients had cholera, 33 salmonella and 65 shigella infections. 23 of the salmonellas and shigellas were found in patients with proved cholera. [Tropical Diseases Bulletin 1975;72(10) abstract 2407 of Bourgeade A, Auvergnat JC, Duchassin M, Kadio A, Bull Soc Med Afr Noire Lang Fr 1974;19(3):281-286] - COUNT NOT USABLE AS A ROW: the 30-month window is not dated in the abstract and the original is offline; the window must lie between the epidemic onset (Oct 1970) and publication (1974). It cannot start at the Oct 1970 onset unless the 749 are only culture-documented cases, because the same service treated 1,200 cholera cases by Sep 1971 (Bourgeade 1971, Index 274, row 1248). Evidence of continued hospitalised cholera in Abidjan into 1972-73 (consistent with Bourgeade 1973 in Remy & Dejours, row 1235: 75 Abidjan cases in 1972). Identification for the task lead '749 cholera among 1895 diarrhoea admissions in 30 months' (Agent 4 batch 10 q12). Agent 5 batch 1 q8.' - cholera confirmed present; no case count available.

source: IFRC DREF Operational Update 1 Cote d'Ivoire Cholera MDRCI018 August 2025
processing_notes: Source states: 'The outbreak quickly spread beyond its initial epicenter. Cases have now been reported in five other health districts: Yopougon Est, Yopougon Ouest, Koumassi, Jacqueville, and Sassandra. The epidemic affects both urban and peri-urban coastal areas, as well as a concerning hotspot in a detention center in Abidjan ... As of 30 July 2025, according to data from the National Institute of Public Health (INHP), 453 cases of cholera have been recorded, including 19 deaths, spread across four health districts: Port-Bouët, Yopougon Est, Koumassi, Yopougon Ouest in Abidjan, Jacqueville and Sassandra health districts. [IFRC MDRCI018 Operational Update 1, Aug 2025]. No Koumassi count is given: the update's district table lists only Port-Bouet/Vridi 200/7, Yopougon Est 228/8, Sassandra 20/3 and Jacqueville 5/1 (= 453/19; rows 37-40), so any Koumassi cases are inside one of those lines (most likely notified by Port-Bouet/Vridi, whose 200 include residents of other districts). Koumassi is NOT among the six districts INHP finally listed as affected (Index 120/36) - treat as residence/alert-level presence. Agent 5 batch 1 q12.' - cholera confirmed present; no case count available.

processing_notes: Source states: ''Ainsi, nous avons obtenu 151 coprocultures positives dans lesquelles 112 ont été retenues pour les raisons suivantes : 1°/ - certains dossiers sont inexploitables ... 2°/ - le germe retrouvé est vibrion parahemoliticus qui n'intervient pas dans le cadre de notre travail 3°/ - les malades provenant des villes voisines ont été écartés ainsi 5 malades originaire de Bonoua ont été éliminés.'
